summary: Upper bound on generated tokens for the response.
combines: Counts visible output tokens AND reasoning tokens together. On a reasoning model with high effort the budget can be consumed entirely by reasoning, returning `status: "incomplete"` with empty text — budget generously (community reports recommend a large headroom at `xhigh`/`max`).
Replaces Chat Completions' `max_tokens`, which is rejected on this endpoint.
range: model-specific; 128,000 for the gpt-5.1 through gpt-5.6 families
note: Don't limit, but if limit is required, set to max allowed
